name: 43160 · Wshngtn Ct Hs, OH
findings: ZIP 43160 (Wshngtn Ct Hs) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43160 (Wshngtn Ct Hs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
59% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
